page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with small marginal notes (Greek letters and numerals) down the right margin. Running head at top, page number at top right, signature at the foot of the right margin.

main_text.p: perimus : creatos esse non ftato tempore, & in menies xii, fed pro re nata, cum bellum gerendum, & exercitus ducendi: defignatos univerfi populi suffragiis sine forte, non eodem semper numero, decem nempe, septem, quinque, tres, duos, unum etiam nonnunquam: emissos esse quo res poscebat & populo placebat, in regionem bellumque unum, aut regiones & bella diversa: fuisse omnes, qui emittebantur, potestate pari in exercitu, summum imperium tenuisse interdum per vices alios post alios, interdum omnes pariter: potestatis modum a populo accepisse, ut vel pro arbitrio suo in expeditione omnia agerent, essentque [illegible, ~3 letters]αὐτοκρατο-ρες[?], nec reddendis rationibus essent obnoxii, vel imperium quidem supremum in exercitu haberent, sed ἀρχοντες[?] deberent. His vero strategis in exercitu terrestri subjuncti erant militum praefecti alii, [illegible, ~3 letters]ut ordinum ductores x tributim lecti, quos ταξιάρχους[?] vocabant, quorum quilibet parti peditum decimae [illegible, ~3 letters]gravis armaturae praerat, potestate strategis proximi [illegible, ~2 letters]: Taxiarchis inferiores praefecti parebant. Tum ἵππαρχοι equitum magistri duo, & his subjecti φύλαρχοι, ut quidem censet Sigonius, decem

page.notes: The scan is low resolution. Greek words and their accents are uncertain and marked [?]. Marginal notes on the right are small Greek letters and numerals that cannot be read reliably; each is marked illegible with an approximate letter count, and their exact placement beside the text lines is approximate. The bottom-right gathering signature is also illegible. The word "decem" printed in the margin near the foot is transcribed as a note. The text runs on from the previous page, so the first paragraph is marked cont="true". The Latin is copied as printed, including the printed "fufrragiis"-style spellings where legible, and the "Taxiarchis" form is kept as printed.
